entities.name: Neyali
entities.description: Vulshok rebel from the Oxidda Chain on New Phyrexia who leads a resistance cell with phoenixes.

entities.name: Oxidda Chain
entities.description: Mountain range that was Neyali's homeland.

entities.name: Otharri
entities.description: Blazing phoenix that hatched from the egg Neyali found.

entities.name: Elham
entities.description: Previous leader of the resistance cell at Slagmaw.

entities.name: Reyana
entities.description: Neyali's childhood friend, compleated by Slobad.

events.summary: Neyali finds a faintly glowing egg and takes it in; soon after the Phyrexians destroy her village, leaving only her and the egg.
events.quote: leaving Neyali and her egg as the only ones left alive

events.summary: Cornered by Phyrexian centurions, Neyali sees the egg hatch into the phoenix Otharri, which incinerates her attackers.
Guided by Otharri, Neyali reaches the rebel camp Slagmaw.
events.quote: Neyali reached Slagmaw, a hidden Mirran rebel camp

events.summary: Neyali takes leadership of the resistance cell from Elham.
events.quote: Neyali took up leadership of the resistance cell from Elham

events.summary: Neyali is captured while trying to save Reyana from compleation, but escapes with Otharri's help.
events.quote: Though Neyali was captured, she escaped with Otharri's help

relations.quote: Neyali took up leadership of the resistance cell from Elham
chose to be compleated by Slobad
